meta.title: Directory listings
meta.description: Check and decide on NGO directory listings.

adminDirectory.title: Directory listings
adminDirectory.lead: Check each listing and its proof, then verify, reject, suspend or reinstate it. Every decision needs a reason, which the listing's owner sees.

forbidden.title: Only FOA admins can see this
forbidden.body: Ask a super admin for the staff admin role if you need it.

meta.title: Check a listing
meta.description: Every detail of one directory listing, its proof and its decision.

notFound.title: No listing with that link
notFound.body: It may have been typed wrongly. Go back to the list to find it.

review.documentsLead: Opening a file is recorded in the audit log.
review.checklistTitle: What FOA expects for this type
review.checklistNote: A guide until FOA confirms its checklist; it isn't enforced.
review.documentUnavailable: This file can't be opened: it is still being checked, or it was refused.
review.noDecision: There is nothing more to decide: a listing that wasn't accepted or was withdrawn stays that way. Its owner can register again.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: The listing's owner sees this. Up to {max} characters.
reason.required: Write a reason for this decision.

decided.verified: Verified. The listing is on the directory, and its owner now represents it.
decided.rejected: Rejected. The owner will be told why.
decided.suspended: Suspended. The listing is off the directory, and the owner will be told why.
decided.reinstated: Reinstated. The listing is back on the directory.

alerts.transition_not_allowed: That decision isn't possible any more: someone else may have decided first. The page now shows the current status.
alerts.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a few minutes.
